info.name: Can you please give Baine a helping hand?
info.parent: A mysterious entity onboard The Nautilus

descriptions.notStarted: Baine's job is to monitor the sound waves of The Nautilus. The way the ship sounds is a good indicator of the overall well-being of the ship. Recently, Baine had apparently detected a strange sound coming through the walls on the lower deck. Could this be an ominous sign of things to come?
descriptions.inProgress: When Baine detects the strange sound waves coming from The Nautilus, he asks #bBart#k, the  #bkeeper of the Watchtower#k, whether he's noticed any changes in sight. The watchtower is apparently on the eastern end of the shipping dock so I'd better look around carefully.
descriptions.completed: Bart says that he's noticed some strange movements. I wonder what he saw?
